title: Docs: add API key rotation + revocation guide
author: Avery Johnson
release_notes: Add customer-facing documentation for Hosted API key rotation and revocation.
description:
Adds a new docs page covering Hosted API key rotation (regeneration) and revocation.

Motivation
- Support keeps answering the same question across tickets and Slack.
- Customers frequently confuse key id vs key value; doc calls this out explicitly.

What
- New page: `auth/api-key-rotation-revocation`
- Adds troubleshooting section (401s after rotation, propagation delays)
- Adds note: do not paste keys in tickets/email

Review notes
- Security asked that we state emergency sequence as: revoke first, then create new key.
- Added mention that enterprise plans have Audit Logs for key lifecycle events.

Conversation (highlights)
Jasmine Liu: Can we be explicit about overlap strategy? e.g., create new key, deploy, validate, then revoke old key for planned rotations.
Avery Johnson: Added "two-key overlap" steps and emphasized revoke-first for suspected compromise.

Irene Choi: Please add a restriction note: support can only revoke on behalf of customer with explicit authorization documented.
Avery Johnson: Added to internal playbook, and added a short note in doc referencing authorization requirements for admin-assisted revokes.

Merge
- Merged via squash on 2024-11-06
